messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-12 released on CRAN
parts:
This is a maintenance release, mostly fixing several issues that have been reported in the last two/three months (see Version History on the lavaan website)

Planned for 0.5-13:
- factor scores for categorical data
- theta parameterization for categorical data
- bootstrapping for categorical data
- standard errors for standardized parameters

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan 0.5-12 released on CRAN
parts:
On 03/11/2013 01:09 PM, Malcolm Bang wrote:
> Are there plans for implementing bayesian estimation i lavaan?

There are so many plans. Bayesian estimation is one of them. We are
already working on a BUGS interface (model specification is done using
lavaan syntax, this syntax is converted to BUGS input, BUGS does all the
work, and the results are stored in a lavaan object). But we do plan to
include a native Bayesian engine into lavaan too. But this is not for
tomorrow...

Yves.
